=====================================
Fields inside ordinary and aliased supertypes
=====================================

[a] [a, ...b] alias ...c; assign ...d; restrict ...e; single ...f; pair ...g h;

---

(source_file
  (list (name))
  (list (name) spread: (spread (name)))
  (aliased (wrapped spread: (spread (name))))
  (assigned spread: (spread (name)))
  (restricted spread: (spread (name)))
  (wrapped_single spread: (spread (name)))
  (wrapped_pair spread: (spread (name)) spread: (name)))
